notes.title: Small update 1.2.59
notes.content:
The last achievement has been fixed, the camera zoom out/zoom out settings have been silenced, and the FPS display option has been enabled/disabled.
Getting achievements and creating a screenshot of the game when saving have been transferred to an asynchronous stream, I hope there will be less freezing at these moments.

notes.title: Major update 1.2.53
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424484/e0a65b0a31f2dd8153b47d9bd3c4c5c1ff89630c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424484/71188e2ea08de618218a48c7d712fb47e0fb5a2f.jpg[/img][/url]
Major update 1.2.53
Added new locations and adventures.
Added many small action animations.
The voice acting has been changed in some cases.
Fixed or changed some basic mechanisms.

notes.title: Small update v.1.1.52
notes.content:
1. The interaction beam has been replaced with a capsule with a larger radius, now it will be easier to hit interactig objects, especially with a gamepad.
2. Fixed the transparency of the character after returning to the car after cinematic.
3. Possible disappearance of jugs after loading from a save has been fixed, the required 6 jugs will always be on the location.
Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Small update v.1.1.51
notes.content: More small fixes in the mechanism of cinematics

notes.title: Small update, v.1.1.50
notes.content:
Did you know that if you add -d3d12 to the game launch parameters, forcing the game to run in directx 12, on old processors this significantly increases FPS?

[url=https://www.simpra.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/DX12Enable.jpg]How to add startup parameter in steam[/url]

A small update to prepare for the big in the future.
1. The cinematic system has been seriously reworked, now it works without using hidden copies of the character and due to this, the FPS has slightly increased.
2. Added a picture when starting the game so that it is not so boring to look at a black screen :)
3. Small improvements to the climbing system, possibly solved the bug with the looping animation of hanging when playing with a gamepad after climbing a ledge or moving to a corner wall.
4. Removed unnecessary triggering of the message about the undesirability of leaving far from home when not all the journal items are completed near it.
5. When opening and closing doors, added disabling their collision so that they do not "kick" the character.
6. Updated the fish asset to the latest version.

notes.title: Маленькие исправления v1.1.49
notes.content: Added experimental brightness control in the game options, mainly affects the brightness of the picture indoors. Added smooth dimming when loading-rollback of the game, auto is now much more stable. Other minor improvements.

notes.title: Small update 1.1.48
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with getting stuck in the gamepad control settings in the main menu.
Slightly optimized navigation with buttons in the menu.

notes.title: Small update 1.1.47
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with auto-rotation of the camera to the side when hanging on ropes and when jumping in place when playing with a gamepad.
Fixed the display of the tooltip at the bottom of the jourlan and inventory for playing with a gamepad.
The list of teleportation points near campfires did not scroll with the gamepad - fixed.
Other minor fixes.

Reminder! For those who have already launched the game before update 1.1.46 (previous), and did not configure the buttons, I recommend resetting everything to defaults in the gamepad control settings, or configure it yourself:
1. opening the journal by clicking the right stick,
2. inventory by clicking on the left stick
3. switch camera by pressing the X button.
These buttons have not been configured before and are unlikely to work on their own.

notes.title: Full gamepad support
notes.content:
Added support for the gamepad in the game, added the ability to invert the mouse axes, fixed some other flaws and bugs.

Important! For those who have already launched the game before this update, it is advisable to reset everything to default in the gamepad control settings, or configure it yourself:
1. opening the journal by clicking the right stick,
2. inventory by clicking on the left stick
3. switch camera by pressing the X button.

These buttons have not been configured before and are unlikely to work on their own.

notes.content:
Fixed sometimes reactor core not in start place in reactor on reach ship underground.
Fixed sometimes bug on taking battery, and it not appears in inventory(important for ship location)
Fixed next additional scenario(X.1.X) not go after final return in house, only after load savegame.

notes.title: Big update 1.1.24
notes.content:
At the end, work on the expansion is completed, one of the additions that I plan to add to the game, helping to complement the story and develop it further - closer to the grand idea that is still in the process.

In addition to the add-on, some things have been improved and some bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: light and fixes again v1.0.22
notes.content: Improved control over light. In addition, now when you save the game, distracting windows will not pop up. Fixed a bug with the appearance of the labyrinth map in its original place if you load from the main menu into a save where the map is already in the inventory. Slightly changed the cut scene in the crocodile cave when both Crooks turntables are cleared. Added typing sound to dialogues without voice acting to draw attention to themselves. Other simple little things.

notes.title: Correction of light, dips v1.0.21
notes.content:
Fixed possible bugs with untimely turning on/off of the light of the sun/moon.
Possibly fixed a sudden fall through the ground when loading a game save to the "street" (reloading the same save usually solved the problem, sometimes the ground did not have time to load before the character moved).

notes.title: Optimisation and fixes
notes.content:
A lot of optimization work, in preparation for the appearance of a new location, so that there are no long FPS drops. Not only was it possible to prevent deterioration, but also significantly improve performance in dungeons and even in open areas.
Fixed some non-critical bugs.

notes.title: More minor fixes v1.0.19
notes.content: Fixed a bug where she would not look at the camera if she loaded into the camera mode she was supposed to look at. Slightly fixed the loading area of the tunnel components. Added a message and sound to the lever on the platform above the elevator to indicate that it is not working. Other little things.

notes.title: Fixed bug when loading onto rope and more v1.0.18
notes.content: Fixed a bug with swimming after loading onto a rope. Improved auto restore tooltip and restore point creation. Now, when saving the game, if the car is on wheels and in good condition, its restore point will be saved at the current location. And when landing in a broken or drowned car, even if it is on wheels, a hint about the possibility of recovery will be displayed.
